requires.reason: runs the compiler and the determinism lint
asc lowers the guest to the deterministic wasm32 subset

structural: every non-deterministic AssemblyScript builtin reaches its effect through an env.* WebAssembly import, and the runtime's import allowlist refuses every module other than layerx_v1, so a clock, a socket or an entropy source is refused at validation rather than at review
--use abort=, --use trace= and --use seed= remove those three imports at the source, so a compiled program carries no import outside the frozen seven
--runtime stub removes garbage collection and finalisation, so allocation is a monotonic bump and no object lifetime depends on a collector's schedule

--disable nontrapping-f2i matches the runtime's saturating_float_to_int refusal exactly, and threads, simd, reference-types, exception-handling, tail-calls and extended-const stay off because AssemblyScript disables them by default
the SDK names no f32, f64 or v128 anywhere; amounts are two exact u64 halves and lengths are i32, so no value silently widens to a floating-point double

the source gate refuses number, Date, Math, performance, process, fetch, atomics and parseFloat before the compiler runs, and refuses any ambient function declaration that carries no layerx_v1 binding
